svg.text: Organic matter on a dairy silage rotation
Rotation D on loam: manure after every silage maize, sized to the nitrogen target
Fertilizer applications (kg/ha; manure, slurry and digestate in 1000 l/ha)
OM changes are 6 times the real-world annual value per game year (timeScale 6); on the server 6 game years ≈ 1 real year. Simulation
with typical yields, not an in-game measurement.
